description: This Java class 'ProvisioningValuesLoader' loads default values for NFC provisioning, primarily from a configuration file on external storage, and supplements missing values with system and device-specific data. It handles reading a config file, creating admin extras bundles, and gathering system info like locale, timezone, and WiFi SSID.

classes.name: ProvisioningValuesLoader
classes.description: A loader class that retrieves NFC provisioning configuration values from disk and system settings.

methods.name: loadInBackground
methods.description: Loads configuration values from disk, admin extras, and system info.

methods.name: deliverResult
methods.description: Delivers the loaded values to the client.

methods.name: onStartLoading
methods.description: Starts the loading process, delivering cached data if available.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Resets the loader, clearing cached data.

methods.name: loadFromDisk
methods.description: Reads configuration data from a file on external storage.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Parses the configuration file and loads key-value pairs.

methods.name: gatherAdminExtras
methods.description: Creates a bundle of admin extras from configuration data.

methods.name: loadSystemValues
methods.description: Populates missing values with system and device info like locale, timezone, and WiFi SSID.

methods.name: trimSsid
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from WiFi SSID strings.

methods.name: putIfMissing
methods.description: Helper to insert a key-value pair if the key is absent.
